text:
maria: Heads-up: planning an IMAGE PRUNE + BASE-REBUILD next Tue 02:00 UTC. Goal: remove outdated layers, rebase to alpine:3.19, rotate image signing keys, and run vuln scans. Need RBAC for the build runner, KMS key schedule, and audit log collection aligned.

aj: +1. Do we have a PR for the RBAC change? We should avoid broad svcacct perms during the window.

maria: I opened a draft PR for the build-runner role: narrow permissions for `images.build` and `images.sign`. Link in PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/412. Please review by EOD Friday.

suhas: For audit logs, I'll enable enhanced image-publish logging to cloud-audit for the build CI project. Will also forward logs to the security S3 bucket. Command I used locally: `gcloud logging sinks create sec-image-logs storage.googleapis.com/redwood-sec-logs --log-filter="resource.type=container AND protoPayload.methodName:\"PublishImage\""`

olivia: For KMS: we need to rotate the signing key and ensure old key still verifies images for 72h during rollout. Ops, can you add a key versioning policy and a fallback key?

kevin: Canary plan idea: push new base image to `canary-1` pool first (10% of traffic) with automatic health checks (latency + mem OOM). If metrics are within 5% of baseline for 30m, promote. Rollback: re-pin runtime to previous image tag and revoke canary tag.

aj: For RBAC, suggested constraint: build-runner service account can `signImage` but only on projects `infra-build-*`. No wildcard projects. I'll update the terraform module.

maria: vulns: running `clair` + `grype` on interim images. If medium or higher with public exploit and score >7.0, block promotion and page triage.

olivia: KMS rotation steps (draft):
1) create new key version `v2`
2) sign images with v2 while keeping v1 in verify pool
3) monitor verify failures for 24h
4) retire v1 after 72h
Please check compatibility with our image verifier (it supports key version lists).

kevin: Add a preflight E2E that runs a tiny request loop against canary to catch regressions (1000 reqs, check 95th p50/p95). I can add the job to the release pipeline.

deploy-bot: CI check `image-scan` started: queued -> running. Logs: `Starting grype scan on image: registry.redwood/base:20260315-2`

aj: One more: we need audit trails for who triggered rebuilds. Add `rebuild.initiator` tag and emit in log entry metadata.

maria: action items: (1) @aj update RBAC terraform PR, (2) @suhas enable audit sink + test, (3) @olivia prepare KMS rotation doc, (4) @kevin add canary E2E job, (5) security oncall will monitor vuln alerts during window. I'll schedule a 30m dry-run on Mon 22:00 UTC to validate the pipeline.

olivia: noted. I'll include command snippets for rolling key versions and a verification checklist.

kevin: I'll stub the rollback playbook in runbooks/rebuild-rollback.md. Will include diag queries: `topk(5, container_memory_rss_bytes)` and request error rates.

maria: If anyone expects conflicts with other team deploys during Tue 02:00 UTC, please flag here now. Otherwise I'll send calendar invite and update the infra runbook. :white_check_mark:

aj: No blocker from infra side.

suhas: I'll test log forwarding in the dry-run and post results.

maria: thanks all — will post final checklist after dry-run. :thumbsup:
